headline: Sensex Jumps 898 Points, Nifty Reclaims 25,800 Led by Banking Stocks Defying Global Rout

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Banking stocks led a strong market rally, driving Nifty Bank to a record high.
Foreign fund inflows lifted investor sentiment and boosted benchmark indices.
IT and banking sector buying supported market recovery from early lows.
Indian markets managed to buck global market sell-off and AI-led rout.
whatHappening: Sensex surged 898 points while Nifty 50 closed at 25,801 after reclaiming the 25,800 mark.
Nifty Bank reached a record high during today's trading session.
Markets recovered strongly after opening lower due to weakness in global AI stocks.
SEBI approved IPO float plans for Arohan Financial Services and Pristine Logistics.
summary: Indian benchmark indices staged a strong rally after early trade weakness, with Sensex jumping 898 points and Nifty reclaiming 25,800. The surge was primarily driven by banking stocks pushing Nifty Bank to record highs alongside foreign inflows. Indian equity markets successfully defied a broader global sell-off triggered by AI stock declines.
